name: Language-Aware Images
description: TMDB images in your library's language with a clean fallback to English, no more textless posters.
overview: Drop-in replacement for the built-in TMDB image provider. Enforces a clean cascade: library language → English → (optional) textless. Within each bucket images are sorted by vote_count DESC like TMDB's own /images UI. Fixes jellyfin/jellyfin#9878 (built-in prefers textless over English fallback).
changelog: Adds Jellyfin 12 support (issue #4). Each release now ships two builds from one source: X.Y.Z.0 targets Jellyfin 10.10/10.11 on net8.0, X.Y.Z.1 targets Jellyfin 12 on net10.0. Your server picks the right one automatically, so nothing changes for 10.10 users. Also fixes the within-bucket ordering when 'sort by votes' is off: Jellyfin 12 rounds the rating it sorts on to one decimal, which erased the old tiebreak, so it is now scaled to survive that rounding.
